_comment: Known signature vector shared by telemetry (producer) and specs/003 threat-network (validator). The HMAC KEY is hex(sha256(reporter_secret)) — the threat network stores only that hash and verifies against it, so reporters sign with hex(sha256(secret)), NOT the raw secret (beta-gate C1). Signature = hex(HMAC-SHA256(hex(sha256(reporter_secret)), timestamp + "\n" + nonce + "\n" + sha256hex(body))). All values synthetic.
